name: Yellow Crane Tower (Color)
description: Yellow Crane Tower, one of the "Three Famous Towers in the South of the Yangtze River", is located on the top of Snake Mountain, facing the Yangtze River thousands of miles away. It has a history of more than a thousand years. Cui Hao's poem "Yellow Crane Tower" became famous all over the world, which attracted celebrities and poets from all over the world to come and create countless poems and songs. After the precipitation and baptism of time, the Yellow Crane Tower is now full of the humanistic atmosphere of the Chinese nation and has become a beautiful scene of its own.
